readme.title: Generalized Jacobians (Lean 4.35.0)
readme.excerpt: This Lean component of [NYLL](https://github.com/n-yamaguchi-0729/NYLL) develops generalized Jacobians of algebraic curves, with ordinary Jacobians as the zero-modulus case. It includes Abel–Jacobi maps, unique factorization through generalized Jacobians, torsion and cohomological comparisons. The [mathematical guide](https://n-yamaguchi-0729.github.io/NYLL/libraries/jacobian-varieties/) explains the main results and their hypotheses.
